run_mesh_info_extractor: run the mesh info extractor CLI tool on a 3D mesh file to get oriented bounding box data
extract_urdf_collision_box: extract a URDF collision box XML snippet from a 3D mesh file using oriented bounds
compute_oriented_bounds: compute the oriented bounding box position, orientation, and extents for a given mesh file
load_mesh_with_trimesh: load a 3D mesh file using trimesh and print its basic representation
convert_mesh_to_collision_xml: convert a mesh file into a URDF collision element with box geometry and origin transform
